additional_info.subject: RE: ID0416550-DC/Si-D/MC-[Y2 / R9 313202799038] Problem on connector 2 CRM:00921001667
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
Hope you are doing well.
The CableTempSensor issue on connector 2 was reported by Mr. Cedric Schoepf from SMEG. We have already rebooted the charger remotely, but the issue persists. Please visit the site and perform a thorough visual inspection of the DC pins.
Please provide the following info for further proceedings-
1.Please provide the photos of the DC plug, including the pins, as we want to check for any signs of damage that may be causing the problem with connector 2.
2. For the inspection of the CCS plug please don't unmount the plug, else the claims to Phoenix won't be possible
3. Please measure the CP pin to ground & provide the measurement value. Which should be constant 12V.
Regards,
Beerpal Singh
eMobility Support
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
